Improvements

Equipment scheduling

I made a shared scheduling spreadsheet for frequently used bubble-point and flow equipment so people could plan their work around existing reservations.

Epoxy Project

I designed two experiments to test whether heating the existing epoxy could speed curing and reduce its viscosity.

Heating the epoxy to make it cure quicker

I tested warmer curing conditions and compared cure time and yellowing. The archived photographs show the test setup and resulting mounts.

Heating the epoxy to decrease viscosity for pouring

I warmed and mixed epoxy in a water bath before pouring it. It flowed more readily, although the additional steps made this approach less practical for routine use.

Data consolidation

I brought build variables and test results into one spreadsheet so related results could be found and compared more easily.

Fiber study

I tested adhesive bonding as an alternative to welding fibrous metal. After tensile tests under several curing conditions, I constructed a full-scale tube for further evaluation.
